title: Count the Complement
prompt:
**Scenario.** n ≤ 10^6 numbers. Count pairs (i, j), i < j, whose sum is NOT divisible by 7. Direct checking is O(n²) — dead. What is the restructure?

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** Loop pairs but break early when the sum is divisible

**B)** Count pairs whose sum IS divisible (easy from residues mod 7), then subtract from n(n−1)/2

**C)** Sort and use two pointers on the sum

**D)** Hash every pair sum into a set

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Complement counting: divisible pairs fall out of residue classes in O(n + 7); total pairs is a formula; subtraction finishes instantly.
